findings.title: Fallback locale translations are only pre-loaded inside ApplicationController requests, not in jobs/console/mailers
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded! is only invoked from ApplicationController#set_locale (app/controllers/application_controller.rb line ~159). The actual lookup used by I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate calls `super(fallback, key, ...)` directly on the backend instance, bypassing the patched `I18n.translate` in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb that performs lazy `load_locale`. That means a fallback locale's YAML translations are only guaranteed to be loaded in memory when a web request goes through ApplicationController#set_locale beforehand. Any translation performed outside of a controller request lifecycle (Sidekiq jobs, mailers triggered from jobs, rake tasks, console) for a user whose locale differs from the default will not have the fallback locale(s) loaded, so a missing key in the user's locale will not actually fall back to the site default or English — it will just be reported as missing. This defeats the purpose of the fallback feature in exactly the contexts (async notifications/digests in minority locales) where it matters most.

findings.title: No tests for the new fallback locale chain or load-triggering logic
findings.body: This PR introduces a new FallbackLocaleList class that computes a fallback chain (user locale -> site default -> :en) and a new ensure_loaded! helper, plus a corresponding before_filter in ApplicationController. No specs were added to verify the fallback order, the dedup/compact behavior, that ensure_loaded! actually causes the expected locale files to load, or that end-to-end translation lookups correctly fall back when a key is missing in the primary locale. Given this is a behavior-changing feature (removing config.i18n.fallbacks = true and replacing it with custom logic), lack of test coverage risks silent regressions.

findings.title: PR description provides no explanation of the change
findings.body: The PR description is just "Test 9", with no explanation of why config.i18n.fallbacks was removed from three environment files in favor of a hand-rolled FallbackLocaleList, what the fallback chain semantics are, or what testing was performed. For a feature that changes global I18n fallback behavior and touches a performance-sensitive translation cache, reviewers and future maintainers have no context to evaluate correctness or intended behavior.
